Description:
• Common cold is a mild viral infection of nose and throat.
• It usually causes cough, sneezing, runny nose and sore throat.
• It spreads through droplets and close contact.
• Most cases improve within a few days with rest.
Precaution:
• Take proper rest.
• Drink warm water and fluids.
• Avoid cold drinks and ice cream.
• Use mask and maintain hygiene.
• Consult doctor if fever or cough continues.
Medication:
• Use medicines only after doctor/pharmacist advice.
• Avoid antibiotics unless prescribed.
• Steam inhalation may help relieve blocked nose.
• Do not take multiple cold tablets together.
Diet:
• Drink warm soups and herbal fluids.
• Eat fruits rich in vitamin C.
• Take soft and light food.
• Avoid oily and cold food items.
Workout:
• Avoid heavy workout during fever.
• Do light walking only if comfortable.
• Take enough sleep.
• Resume normal exercise after recovery.

Description:
• Viral fever is caused by viral infection.
• It commonly causes fever, weakness, headache and body pain.
• It may last for a few days depending on immunity.
• High fever should be monitored carefully.
Precaution:
• Take complete rest.
• Drink plenty of water.
• Check temperature regularly.
• Avoid crowded places.
• Consult doctor if fever lasts more than 3 days.
Medication:
• Take fever medicine only with medical advice.
• Do not take antibiotics without prescription.
• ORS can help if weakness or dehydration is present.
• Avoid self-medication.
Diet:
• Drink water, ORS and fresh juices.
• Eat rice, dal, soups and soft food.
• Include fruits and vegetables.
• Avoid spicy and oily foods.
Workout:
• Avoid exercise during fever.
• Do breathing and light stretching after recovery.
• Sleep properly.
• Restart workout slowly.

Description:
• Fungal infection affects skin areas.
• It causes itching, rash, redness and scaling.
• It can spread in moist and sweaty areas.
• Hygiene is important to control it.
Precaution:
• Keep skin clean and dry.
• Wear loose cotton clothes.
• Do not share towels or clothes.
• Avoid scratching affected area.
• Consult dermatologist if spreading.
Medication:
• Use antifungal cream only after medical advice.
• Do not use steroid creams without doctor.
• Complete full treatment if prescribed.
• Keep affected area dry.
Diet:
• Eat balanced healthy food.
• Reduce excess sugar intake.
• Drink enough water.
• Include fruits and vegetables.
Workout:
• Normal activity is fine.
• Avoid sweating too much.
• Shower after workout.
• Wear clean dry clothes.
